intro: ImagePlayground is the Evotec PowerShell module for visual automation. It wraps ChartForgeX, ChartForgeX.Visuals and ChartForgeX.Stories, so a script can turn objects into charts, service maps, dashboards, social cards and animated terminal stories.
note: Each example below is taken from the Examples folder of the ImagePlayground repository and shown next to the file it produced.

showcases.title: A social card from three info tiles
showcases.body: New-ImageCanvas composes fixed-size artwork: text, tiles with mini charts, progress and accents from the Graphite tokens.
showcases.code:
$tokens = [ChartForgeX.Themes.VisualDesignTokens]::GraphiteDark()

New-ImageCanvas -Preset SocialPreview -Theme Dark -Title 'Service health overview' -LayerDefinition {
    New-ImageCanvasText -X 72 -Y 72 -Width 1056 -Text 'Service health' -FontSize 58 -Color $tokens.Foreground -Emphasized
    New-ImageCanvasText -X 72 -Y 154 -Width 1056 -Text 'A clear view of requests, latency, and capacity' -FontSize 26 -Color $tokens.MutedForeground
    New-ImageCanvasInfoTile -X 72 -Y 260 -Width 336 -Height 176 -Icon API -Label Requests -Value '12,840' -Detail '+12% this week' -Accent $tokens.Accent -MiniChartKind Area -MiniValues 8200, 9400, 10100, 12840
    New-ImageCanvasInfoTile -X 432 -Y 260 -Width 336 -Height 176 -Icon DB -Label 'Database latency' -Value '32 ms' -Detail 'Above the 25 ms target' -Accent $tokens.Warning -MiniChartKind Sparkline -MiniValues 18, 21, 24, 32
    New-ImageCanvasInfoTile -X 792 -Y 260 -Width 336 -Height 176 -Icon CPU -Label Capacity -Value '74%' -Detail '26% available' -Accent $tokens.Positive -Progress 0.74
} -FilePath social-preview-dark.png

showcases.title: A service health dashboard
showcases.body: Metric cards, lists, tables and timelines become one grid with New-ImageVisualGrid, exported as HTML, SVG or PNG.

showcases.title: An animated terminal session
showcases.body: New-ImageConsoleStory records authored commands and output as a GIF, APNG, SVG or HTML replay. The displayed commands are never executed.

showcases.title: A service map in five lines
showcases.body: Nodes and edges carry kind, status and labels. New-ImageTopology lays them out and writes SVG, PNG or interactive HTML.
showcases.code:
$definition = {
    New-ImageTopologyNode -Id gateway -Label Gateway -Kind Network -Status Healthy -Symbol GW -Width 180 -Height 72
    New-ImageTopologyNode -Id api -Label 'Application API' -Kind Service -Status Healthy -Symbol API -Width 180 -Height 72
    New-ImageTopologyNode -Id database -Label Database -Kind Database -Status Warning -Symbol SQL -Width 180 -Height 72
    New-ImageTopologyEdge -SourceNodeId gateway -TargetNodeId api -Label HTTPS -Kind Connectivity -Status Healthy -Direction Forward
    New-ImageTopologyEdge -SourceNodeId api -TargetNodeId database -Label '32 ms' -Kind Dependency -Status Warning -Direction Forward
}

New-ImageTopology -TopologyDefinition $definition -Title 'Service topology' -Subtitle 'Database latency above target' -Layout Layered -Direction LeftToRight -Theme Dark -Width 900 -Height 420 -Padding 24 -FitContentToViewport -FilePath service-map-dark.png

showcases.title: A chart from typed definitions
showcases.body: Series cmdlets such as New-ImageChartLine return definitions; New-ImageChart renders them with options, themes and titles.
showcases.code:
$trend = @(
    New-ImageChartLine -Name 'CPU' -Value 31,42,37,55,68,61,74,58,49,63 -Marker Circle -Smooth
    New-ImageChartLine -Name 'Memory' -Value 48,51,55,57,60,62,59,64,66,69 -Marker Circle -Smooth
)

$options = New-ImageChartOptions -ShowLegend -LegendPosition Bottom -TickCount 4
New-ImageChart -Definition $trend -Title 'Resource usage' -Subtitle 'Ten samples from one workstation' -Theme Dark -ShowGrid -XTitle 'Sample' -YTitle 'Usage %' -Options $options -FilePath ChartsChartForgeXTrend.png -Width 760 -Height 420
